description: Extract the settlement clause of a single Polymarket (.com or .us) or Kalshi market: who publishes the settling number (source), the clock time + timezone it is taken at (falling back to the market TITLE when the clause itself says "the time range specified in the title", e.g. Polymarket's 15-minute Chainlink TWAP family), the precision of the computation (e.g. "1-minute candle close" vs "60-second trailing average" vs "twap_60s_lookback"/"twap_30s_lookback" vs "election outcome"), comparison_ba

market.description: Polymarket (.com or .us) market slug or URL, OR a Kalshi market ticker (preferred) or event ticker (falls back to a representative market under that event).

venue.description: Which venue to fetch the market from. "polymarket" is the offshore venue (polymarket.com); "polymarket-us" is the separate, CFTC-regulated polymarket.us venue, matched by slug via its own search (no exact-slug lookup exists upstream).
